module: Lua driver for license plates drawn with Skia. It generates the plate text from the patterns of design.vars (literal text and {token} tokens), builds the variable table ({plate}, {line1}/{line2}, {seg1}..., predefined or generated variables), substitutes each {key} in a copy of the layout tree of the chosen format, then sends the resolved result to the C++ engine (veh:renderLicensePlateSkia), which binds the textures to the @licenseplate-* material tags. The C++ only does the rendering. Useful for plate mods (*.sktemplate.json files).
usage:
local design = jsonReadFile('vehicles/common/licenseplates/default/licensePlate-default.sktemplate.json')
local text = core_skiaTemplate.generateText(design, veh)
core_skiaTemplate.renderToVehicle(veh, design, 'default', text)
notes: A design is a table: type ('licenseplate' by default), format (table name -> {size, background, normal, emboss, finish, maps, segments, limit, limit2, root}), vars (variable definitions: default, formats, charsets, preset), logic (name of an optional Lua module with resolve(text, format, design) that may return {vars, nodes, background, normal}).
Rendered maps: for type licenseplate, diffuse, normal, specular, metallic; for other types, diffuse only. An explicit maps list in the format or the design takes precedence.
Predefined (preset) and generated variables are deterministic for a given plate text (djb2 hash of the text) so that all multiplayer clients get the same result.
Empty values are replaced by a space; an unknown token stays as is ({key}).
limit and limit2 count UTF-8 code points, not bytes.

Special tokens of generateText: {vid} (vehicle id), {vname} (jbeam file name), and the character sets of vars.plate.charsets. The chosen plate formats come from the vehicle's dynamic field licenseFormats (default {"30-15"}).

generateText.desc: Generates a plate text from design.vars.plate (literal text and {token} tokens). Without a usable variable, falls back to an 'AAA-0000' style.

resolveFormat.desc: Resolves a design format into a flat template understood by the engine: {size, background, normal, emboss, finish, maps, root} with all {key} substituted. finish contains the default PBR values (0 to 1): roughness and metallic for the background, fgRoughness and fgMetallic for the text and logos; a node can override with its own metallic/roughness. Also applies the splitting into segments, into lines (limit/limit2) and the design logic if any.

text.desc: Plate text (empty replaced by a space).

returns.desc: Resolved template; nil if the format or its root is missing.

resolveTemplate.desc: Resolves a generic (non-plate) flat template {size, background?, root}: deep copy and substitution of the {key} of the text from vars. maps is diffuse only unless otherwise specified.

returns.desc: Resolved template; nil if there is no root.

renderToVehicle.desc: Resolves the format then submits it to the engine's Skia rendering thread (veh:renderLicensePlateSkia with the resolved JSON), which binds the result to the vehicle's @licenseplate-* material tags.

returns.desc: false if the vehicle cannot render or the format is not found; otherwise the engine's return (true if accepted).

benchmark.desc: Development tool: compares CPU and GPU rendering of the plate maps. Renders synchronously on the calling thread, so run it when no plate is being created.

design.desc: Design, or VFS path of a *.sktemplate.json (default: standard plate vehicles/common/licenseplates/default/licensePlate-default.sktemplate.json).

format.desc: Format; by default the first of the design.

returns.desc: Timing summary returned by the engine, or an error message (skiaBenchmark unavailable outside a dev build with Skia, design not found, format not renderable).
